shortDescription: The U.S. Navy awarded Leidos Holdings $926 million for the second option year of the Next Generation Enterprise Network Service Management, Integration and Transport contract. "Leidos Holdings: US Navy Awards $875M for Second Option Yr on Contract to Secure and Maintain Critical Networks Worldwide…

children: The U.S. Navy awarded Leidos Holdings $926 million for the second option year of the Next Generation Enterprise Network Service Management, Integration and Transport contract. "Leidos Holdings: US Navy Awards $875M for Second Option Yr on Contract to Secure and Maintain Critical Networks Worldwide >LDOS," at 4:31 p.m. ET on Sept. 14, misstated the amount in the headline.

title: Correction to U.S. Navy Awards Leidos Holdings Second Option Year Headline on Sept. 14
